input.title: Attention Is All You Need
input.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

input.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
input.abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context.

input.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
input.abstract: We report the development of GPT-4, a large-scale, multimodal model which can accept image and text inputs and produce text outputs. While less capable than humans in many real-world scenarios, GPT-4 exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.

input.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
input.abstract: We study empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss. The loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training.

input.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
input.abstract: As AI systems become more capable, we would like to enlist their help to supervise other AIs. We experiment with methods for training a harmless AI assistant through a process we call constitutional AI (CAI).

input.title: Flash Attention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
input.abstract: Transformers are slow and memory-hungry on long sequences, since the time and memory complexity of self-attention are quadratic in sequence length. We propose FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce memory reads/writes.

input.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
input.abstract: Large pre-trained language models have been shown to store factual knowledge in their parameters. We explore a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

input.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
input.abstract: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture.

input.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
input.abstract: We explore how generating a chain of thought — a series of intermediate reasoning steps — significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning.

input.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
input.abstract: We present high quality image synthesis results using diffusion probabilistic models. Our best results are obtained by training on a weighted variational bound designed according to a novel connection between diffusion models and denoising score matching.
